description: AfAMax provides free, non-binding calculations for German residential real estate. Estimate building depreciation (AfA), remaining useful life, annual and monthly depreciation, indicative tax effects, or allocate a purchase price between land and building using the German BMF methodology. Inputs are validated, tools are read-only and idempotent, and results include assumptions, limitations, attribution, and a disclaimer. Operated by Rundum Immo UG in Heidelberg, Germany. For informational planning only; not a substitute for tax, legal, or professional appraisal advice.
